calls.name: Mortimer
greet: Evening. The house takes visitors after dark. The front door is open.
Mind the steps. The pumpkins bite.

calls.name: Agatha
greet: Come in, come in. Mind the cat.
Ah, a guest. The brew is nearly ready.

do.text: Something bubbles. A fresh potion stands on the kitchen table.
The brew heaves up out of the cauldron as a ghost.
